jobs.description:
Are you looking for a varied job as a driver at a large family company? At H.Essers in Bergen op Zoom, you are an important colleague and not just a number. You get the space to show your skills on both the forklift and the reach truck. You will work in a great team with a good atmosphere. The best part? You work in the day shift. This means you are home on time every evening for your own plans.

What we offer
- € 15.05 per hour, with annual increases!
- Always home on time with the day shift!
- Get your certificates at our expense!
- Access to 3000 + digital trainings!
- Part of the friendliest logistics team!
- A great chance for a permanent contract!

Who you are
You are a handy driver who likes to get to work.

- You speak good Dutch or good English.
- You have experience on the reach truck and forklift.
- You are available fulltime.

What will you do
You make sure all goods are placed in the right spot in the warehouse. One moment you use the forklift to load or unload trucks. The next moment you jump on the reach truck to put pallets high up in the racks. You keep a clear overview and make sure everything happens safely. Thanks to your skills, the process in the warehouse runs smoothly. You are the essential link that ensures orders are ready on time.

Where will you work
You will start at the H.Essers site in Bergen op Zoom. This is a large family business where the atmosphere is very friendly and informal. Because it is a family business, the lines between colleagues are short and everyone helps each other. You work at a place where many different goods arrive, from chemicals to luxury products. This means your workday is never boring and time flies. Because of this great atmosphere, you will quickly feel at home with your new colleagues.
